description: Source code for handling file uploads, including session management, plugin hooks, file info generation, and image processing in Mattermost server.

methods.name: genFileInfoFromReader
methods.description: Generates file metadata including MIME type, size, and image dimensions if applicable.

methods.name: runPluginsHook
methods.description: Executes plugin hooks for file upload, allowing plugins to modify or reject uploads.

methods.name: CreateUploadSession
methods.description: Creates a new upload session with specified parameters and saves it to the store.

methods.name: GetUploadSession
methods.description: Retrieves an upload session by its ID.

methods.name: GetUploadSessionsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all upload sessions associated with a specific user.

methods.name: UploadData
methods.description: Handles uploading data chunks, manages session locking, finalizes uploads, generates file info, runs plugin hooks, processes images, and cleans up sessions.
